subject: Split invoicing request for multi-year prepay — rev rec alignment
messages:
From: Suzanne Hunt <suzanne.hunt@glyphhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Morris <paul_morris@glyphhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T14:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal questions — multi-year prepay

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the proposal. Quick question from our Finance team: we can commit to a 3-year prepay at the discounted rate, but we need the invoicing split across fiscal years (FY27, FY28, FY29) for budgeting/CapEx purposes.

Is Redwood able to issue three separate invoices (one per contract year) while keeping the contract as one multi-year agreement? Our controller wants the invoice schedule reflected on the DocuSign summary page and prefers annual invoices to align with tax/forecasting.

Also, can you confirm how Redwood will treat revenue recognition for a prepay like this (will you provide a deferral/amortization statement we can include with our auditors)?

Appreciate your help — we want to keep the discount but need to ensure accounting lines up.

Best,
Suzanne
Procurement Manager, Glyph Health

---
Attachment: PO-Template-Glyph.docx (referenced)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Suzanne Hunt <suzanne.hunt@glyphhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Paul Morris <paul_morris@glyphhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal questions — multi-year prepay

Hi Suzanne — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate split invoicing while keeping a single master agreement.

A few bullets so Finance has the details they need:
- Billing options we support:
  • Single upfront invoice (customer prepay) — common, simpler cash handling.
  • Split invoicing (one invoice per contract year) — what you asked for; each invoice is issued at contract signing but invoiced as Year 1/Year 2/Year 3 line items with separate invoice numbers.
  • Annual invoices triggered on each anniversary — possible but affects discounting and quoting.
- For revenue recognition: Redwood treats prepaid consideration as deferred revenue and recognizes it over the service period (typically straight-line monthly unless there are discrete performance milestones). We can provide a revenue deferral schedule in spreadsheet form to attach to your AR records.
- We'll include invoice numbers and invoice dates that map to each fiscal year as requested. Our billing team will annotate the invoices: "Prepaid contract DL-78934 — Year N of 3".

Next steps I propose: I will loop in Billing to confirm the mechanics and get a sample invoice PDF for FY27 formatting. Marissa, Karthik — can you confirm whether the discount needs to be re-priced if we issue three separate invoice numbers at signing (i.e., does the economics change for Redwood)?

Suzanne/Paul — if that sounds good I can attach the sample invoice to the DocuSign packet so your controller has the exact document.

Thanks,
Alex
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: Redwood_Rate_Card_3yr_prepay.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Billing Team <billing@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-04T08:23:00Z
Subject: RE: Proposal questions — multi-year prepay

On Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 16:05, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marissa, Karthik — can you confirm whether the discount needs to be re-priced if we issue three separate invoice numbers at signing (i.e., does the economics change for Redwood)?

Alex/Suzanne — Billing confirmed: we can issue three invoice numbers at signing with fixed amounts per invoice. The discount is tied to the overall contracted committed spend (deal DL-78934), not the invoice count, so the customer keeps the quoted 18% term discount as long as they prepay the full committed amount up front.

Accounting notes to pass to Glyph's controller:
- Revenue treatment: per ASC 606 we will defer the prepaid consideration and recognize revenue ratably over the 36-month service period unless the agreement defines material non-linear delivery (not the case here).
- We will provide a one-page deferral schedule (CSV and PDF) showing invoice amount, invoice date, deferred balance, monthly recognized revenue, and unearned revenue at each month end.
- For audit purposes we will attach: the fully executed contract, DocuSign audit trail, invoice PDFs, and the deferral schedule.

Billing will prepare a sample set of three invoice PDFs with numbering: RW-2026-78934-Y1, RW-2026-78934-Y2, RW-2026-78934-Y3.

Karthik — please confirm whether Legal needs any special language in the MSA to note "split invoicing for budgeting purposes" (I think a short clause is adequate).

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: Draft_SLA_appendix_v2.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Billing Team <billing@redwood.ai>
Cc: Suzanne Hunt <suzanne.hunt@glyphhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:41:00Z
Subject: RE: Proposal questions — multi-year prepay

Marissa — legal ok on short clause. Suggested language for the MSA amendment: "Customer and Redwood agree that, notwithstanding single execution of the Agreement and payment of prepaid consideration, Redwood may issue multiple invoices referencing the same contractual commitment for budgeting and internal accounting purposes. Such allocation shall not affect the economic terms or the timing of service delivery, and revenue recognition shall be governed by Redwood's standard accounting policies."

Please add this as a one-paragraph amendment in the DocuSign packet. Suzanne — we will not change the discount or the payment terms; this is purely an invoicing and administrative allocation.

Karthik
General Counsel (interim), Redwood Inference
